messages.headline: Winter Weather Advisory from Wednesday evening to Thursday morning
messages.description: Snow showers and slick roads are expected over the pass.
messages.instruction: Slow down and allow extra travel time.

messages.headline: Wind Advisory from Friday noon to midnight
messages.description: West winds with strong gusts are expected in the high country.
messages.instruction: Secure loose objects and use caution with high-profile vehicles.

messages.headline: Wind Advisory now lasts until Saturday 6 AM
messages.description: Gusty west winds continue through Friday night in the high country.
messages.instruction: Secure loose objects and use caution with high-profile vehicles.

messages.headline: Air Quality Alert for wildfire smoke until Saturday noon
messages.description: Smoke is expected to reach levels that are unhealthy for sensitive groups along the coast.
messages.instruction: People with heart or lung disease, older adults and children should limit time outdoors.

messages.headline: Air Quality Alert extended to Saturday midnight; smoke is now unhealthy
messages.description: Monitors along the coast report unhealthy smoke levels overnight.
messages.instruction: Everyone should limit time outdoors; keep windows closed.

messages.headline: Air Quality Alert cancelled
messages.description: Onshore winds cleared the smoke earlier than forecast.

messages.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory from Friday 4 PM to Saturday 4 AM
messages.description: High tides may flood low roads and parking areas along the bay shore.
messages.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roads. Move vehicles from low parking areas.

messages.headline: Freeze Warning from 2 AM to 9 AM Saturday
messages.description: Temperatures near or below freezing are expected in the heights.
messages.instruction: Protect tender plants and outdoor pipes.

messages.headline: Dense Fog Advisory from 4 AM to 9 AM Saturday
messages.description: Patchy dense fog may reduce visibility in the valley.
messages.instruction: Use low beams and leave extra following distance.
